findings.title: Call to undefined method isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments. The superclass UsernamePasswordForm only defines isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel user) in this PR, and no no-argument method exists in this class or its parents. This is a compile-time error. The intended call is likely isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()), or a no-arg helper needs to be added.

findings.title: Conditional passkey setup is skipped when no user is known
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns false unless user != null. Both authenticate (line 115) and the error challenge override (line 137) use this method to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm(context). On the initial login screen and after errors such as unknown username, context.getUser() is null, so the WebAuthn conditional UI challenge/attributes are not set. This regresses passkey login from the first login form and contradicts tests that expect the webauth form on the initial page.
